## Change

Describe the user-facing change and why it is needed.

## Verification

List the commands run, their outcomes, and any skipped or unavailable checks.

- [ ] Repository documentation and generated overview assets are consistent.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; skipped data-dependent tests are identified.
- [ ] Frozen policy, archived data, upstream source, and existing releases are unchanged.
- [ ] No molecular experiment, visibility change, or new performance claim is introduced unintentionally.
- [ ] New documentation and figure labels are in English.
- [ ] No credentials, raw packages, caches, or proprietary fonts are included.
